acceptance_criteria: harness.hooks._paths.load_self_healing_history(state_dir) returns a list[dict] parsed line-by-line from state/control/autowork/self_healing_history.jsonl (or [] when absent)
harness.hooks._paths.matching_history_records(records, files_touched) returns the subset whose files_touched share at least one entry with the provided list
harness.hooks._paths.format_self_healing_section(matches) returns a string opening with '--- RECENT SELF-HEALING HISTORY FOR RELATED COMPONENTS ---' or '' when matches is empty

edge_cases: self_healing_history.jsonl contains malformed JSON lines mixed with valid ones.
Records use a string instead of a list for files_touched.
functional_requirements: Implement load_self_healing_history(state_dir: pathlib.Path) -> list[dict] that reads state/control/autowork/self_healing_history.jsonl line by line, skipping blank or malformed lines, and returns [] when the file is absent or unreadable.

Implement matching_history_records(records: list[dict], files_touched: list[str]) -> list[dict] that returns the records whose files_touched share at least one path string with the provided files_touched list, preserving input order.

Implement format_self_healing_section(matches: list[dict]) -> str that returns '' when matches is empty, otherwise a section beginning with the literal header '--- RECENT SELF-HEALING HISTORY FOR RELATED COMPONENTS ---' followed by one line per record summarising ts, task_id, outcome, and shared files.
spec.implementation_notes: Use json.loads inside a try/except per line so a single corrupt row does not poison the rest of the file. Coerce files_touched to list[str] defensively before set-intersection. The section format should be machine-readable but agent-facing: include ISO timestamp formatted from the float ts via datetime.fromtimestamp.
spec.interfaces: Three new module-level functions exported from harness/hooks/_paths.py. No changes to existing functions.
non_goals: Do not modify other validation checks or gates on task promotion.
Do not alter the existing load_inbox_task contract or other path helpers.
spec.objective: Centralise the JSONL history read, overlap filter, and warning-section formatter so Claude and Gemini hooks share one implementation and one test surface.
